card.name: Resuming treatment at a stated dose
card.fires_on: The word right after a resume, restart or reinitiate verb, such as "at", or the dose word after "previously prescribed". It appears in dose-adjustment instructions after a hold or stop.

modes.label: Resume at a dose
modes.description: The word "at" right after resume, restart or reinitiate, leading into a same or reduced dose.
modes.example: Resume<< at>> reduced dose. Grade 4 Perman

modes.label: Return to prior dose
modes.description: A word completing a phrase about going back to the earlier dose, such as "used" or "dose" after "previously prescribed".
modes.example: then resuming the previously prescribed<< dose>> may be considered.

card.writes: It seems to push toward words meaning previous or earlier, such as "previously" and "(previous".
